title: Imagined melody identification
scientific_question: Can a model infer the instructed excerpt class from a fixed no-concurrent-audio EEG window of an excluded participant, with performance beyond a matched zero-waveform control?
primary_outputs: The instructed excerpt identifier in canonical class order[1,2,3,4,11,12,13,14,21,22,23,24]; it is not a verified report of the participant’s subjective melody content.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Complete64-channel source-ordered windows after within-sample average reference and fixed four-sample averaging 512 Hz→128 Hz; no outside-window padding or fitted session preprocessing is added.

All permitted labeled training windows from other nine participants, opaque group aliases and four sealed reference states for the current fold/view. ZERO replaces all training/query waveforms with positive float32 zeros while retaining support and labels.
forbidden_inputs: Held-person labeled calibration, other query windows or query batches, prior conversations, cross-query state, target correctness and grading feedback.
Source event timestamps/names, excerpt-coded cues, actual concurrent audio, unrestricted retrieval and model updates shared across episodes.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Canonical IDs privately bind source-event index/onset and participant; candidates receive opaque 32 hex row/group aliases and the exact 12 nonconsecutive class IDs. The complete trial census N is source-dependent and not fabricated here.
allowed_inputs.split: Leave one participant out; train on the other nine. Every admitted condition 4 trial and all 12 classes per participant are required; current-query unlabeled transduction is allowed for candidates but fixed references remain inductive.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Complete10-person support, two waveform views and three replications; all 12 N candidate closures and 240 complete assessment panels are required. Source preparation maps 105 exact prerequisites; N and authentic eligibility are not established by constructor success.

biological_unit: Ten biological participants; multiple excerpt/repetition trials are nested and LOPO training folds overlap.
case_definition: Exactly one current EEG window [64,512], float32 volts at 128 Hz, representing four seconds beginning 0.5 s after source onset.

direct_observation.representation: A fixed 64 channel four-second waveform can support a no-tools numerical/visual observation condition with the same 12-label answer.
direct_observation.boundary: Any direct arm must receive a bounded declared observation and its own matched demonstrations, without numerical/model calls or held labels; programme evidence cannot stand in.
missing: No no-tools packet/renderer and direct-model transport or trial evidence.

primary.name: Participant-macro 12-class balanced accuracy
primary.aggregation: Compute12 class recalls within each of 10 people, average equally across classes and people; report paired I-minus-F and EEG-minus-ZERO separately.
primary.rationale: Weights people and classes equally while preserving the true instruction-label target and mandatory no-waveform comparator.

secondary: Participant-macro NLL with declared 1e-12 log floor; retain probability validation without renormalization.
Complete per-class confusion/recall, paired mode/view contrasts, reference comparisons and three-replication range/sample SD.
Leave-one-person aggregation sensitivity, not retraining or population confidence intervals.

comparators.name: BP_LDA, TM_LDA and RBF_KRR
comparators.inputs: The same complete permitted training windows and group structure for each view.
comparators.procedure: Existing source completes all training-person-held inner settings and temperature selection; strongest family chosen solely from training.

comparators.name: Historical BP_LDA plus uniform and Laplace priors
comparators.inputs: Historical declared training recipe or training class counts only.
comparators.procedure: Existing source preserves historical algorithm as a distinct comparator without claiming numerical parity; analytic priors expose class-frequency shortcuts.

comparators.name: ZERO waveform view
comparators.inputs: Identical labels/group/protocol/budgets but all-zero waveforms in both train and query.
comparators.procedure: Independent reference fitting and both candidate modes run on full unchanged support; no EEG-fitted state transfers to ZERO.

evaluation.uncertainty: Ten fixed people and overlapping LOPO folds support descriptive paired biological effects. Report omission sensitivity and algorithm-replication variation; do not use iid-trial significance or interpret repetitions as people.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require exactly 12 finite[0,1]probabilities summing within 1e-6; no renormalization. Every class/person/view/replication and all 240 panels must close before targets open; incomplete support or unknown closure refuses complete assessment.
